items.title: The Elite Series heads from Hamburg to Bangkok, Las Vegas and Lyon
items.summary: The official 2026/27 schedule opens in Hamburg on 30–31 October, followed by London, Bangkok, Las Vegas and Lyon. Elite 15 and Challenger 15 races share the stage on the road to Hong Kong 2027.
items.take: The useful lesson for everyday racers is planning: pick the event, then build the weeks backwards from it.

items.title: First-timers don't need a ticket to start training
items.summary: Michele's Foundations programme is built for exactly that gap: structured HYROX training before you've ever booked a start line, with the Hyrox Newbies community behind it.
items.take: HYROX isn't a 5k you can just wing — but where you are now is your starting point.

items.title: Elite qualification switches to a rolling points system
items.summary: HYROX's framework uses a rolling 365-day window: the best five singles results or best three doubles results count. Elite Series doubles partners must share the same nationality and an active athlete licence is required.
items.take: The points table matters, but the calendar still has to fit real training and real life.

items.title: Hong Kong to host the 2027 World Championships
items.summary: HYROX announced the first World Championships in the Asia-Pacific region, at Hong Kong's AsiaWorld-Expo on 10–13 June 2027.
items.take: A big target is useful when it turns into manageable sessions this week.
